newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes almost unchanged.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed almost unchanged in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 614.72, up by 0.06 percent from 614.30 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 23.383 million dinars against 781,069 dinars.
"This is exceptional -- most of the trade was on the occasional market," a broker said.
STB bank was up 0.64 dinar to 22.57 dinars. BDET bank and beverages firm SFBT were both up 0.59 dinar to 20.43 dinars and 137.87 dinars respectively. ($=0.96 dinar)
